mapper.sql: shipments.id AS id, shipments.name AS `name`, shipments.modified AS modified, shipments.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM shipments LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = shipments.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = shipments.modified_by
WHERE shipments.is_active = 1 AND shipments.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipments ( name, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{shipment.name}, NOW(), #{shipment.createdBy}, #{shipment.isActive} )
